issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: PR Lens by Coldtea.ai
products.tagline: See code through a new lens
products.summaryZh: 以全新视角审视代码
products.descriptionZh: PR Lens 提供了一种审视代码的新方式。它能绘制任意代码库及每个拉取请求的动画架构与数据流图，让你在阅读任何一行代码之前，就能直观看到变更。它可作为 GitHub Action、命令行工具，或编码代理的技能运行，并以 MIT 许可证开源。
products.description: PR Lens is a new way to look at code. It draws animated architecture and data flow diagrams of any codebase and every pull request, so you see the change before you read a single line of code. It runs as a GitHub Action, on the CLI, or as a skill for your coding agent. Open source under MIT.

products.name: Scriptly
products.tagline: An iOS teleprompter app controlled by your voice
products.summaryZh: 一款由语音控制的iOS提词器应用
products.descriptionZh: 使用Scriptly轻松编写、组织和录制视频。具备实时语音跟随滚动、本地存储隐私及专业提词器工具。在TestFlight上下载公开测试版。
products.description: Write, organize, and record videos effortlessly with Scriptly. Featuring real-time voice-following scrolling, local storage privacy, and professional teleprompter tools. Download the public beta on TestFlight.

products.name: Tucky
products.tagline: Notes docked to your screen edge, with an AI agent inside
products.summaryZh: 停靠在屏幕边缘的笔记，内置AI助手
products.descriptionZh: Tucky是一款原生macOS笔记应用，以屏幕边缘的细条形式静默存在。数据本地存储且加密。Plus版每月4美元，提供语音、连接器及最佳LLM模型。
products.description: Tucky is a native macOS notes app that sleeps as a thin stripe on the screen edge. Local and encrypted. Plus is $4/month for voice, connectors, and the best LLM models.

products.name: Routines by Databox
products.tagline: An AI Analyst that runs analysis and reports on a schedule
products.summaryZh: 按计划执行分析并生成报告的AI分析师。
products.descriptionZh: 给你的AI分析师一个提示词和时间表。它会分析你的实时数据，准备你要求的报告或分析，并通过电子邮件、Slack或应用内发送。你今天手工完成的重复性工作将自动完成。
products.description: Give your AI Analyst a prompt and a schedule. It analyzes your live data, prepares the report or analysis you asked for, and delivers it by email, Slack, or in-app. The recurring work you do by hand today gets done automatically.

products.name: Airuncode
products.tagline: Run multiple local coding agents on your machine
products.summaryZh: 在你的机器上运行多个本地编码代理
products.descriptionZh: Airuncode是一款面向严肃软件工作的本地优先代理运行时。您可以在自己的机器上运行多个编码代理，自带API密钥，在云端与本地模型之间切换，并直接向提供商付费，无任何令牌加价。它能扫描您的代码库，在代理间讨论解决方案，编辑文件，运行测试并自我修复故障。它还内置V-CORE，一个原生Vulkan 3D运行时，用于AI辅助游戏开发。支持Windows、macOS和Linux平台。
products.description: Airuncode is a local-first agent runtime for serious software work. Run multiple coding agents on your machine, bring your own API keys, switch between cloud and local models, and pay providers directly with zero token markup. It scans your codebase, debates solutions across agents, edits files, runs tests and self-heals failures. It also ships with V-CORE, a native Vulkan 3D runtime for AI-assisted game development. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.

products.name: Assist
products.tagline: Voice annotate your Mac, get screenshots + clipboard manager
products.summaryZh: 为Mac添加语音标注，获取截图与剪贴板管理功能
products.descriptionZh: 用语音标注Mac屏幕，截取全屏截图，并将复制的文本随时从刘海处取用。
products.description: Annotate your Mac screen with voice, capture full-screen screenshots, and keep copied text ready to reuse from the notch.

products.name: Bloop
products.tagline: Turn any Mac audio into a visual you can actually export
products.summaryZh: 将任何Mac音频转化为可导出的可视化内容
products.descriptionZh: Bloop将系统音频或麦克风输入转化为八种实时着色器皮肤——每一帧都随实际播放内容动态反应。可将其置于可调整大小的迷你播放器旁，或发送至菜单栏。拖入MP3播放列表，即可将整个内容导出为成品视频。支持Apple Silicon，已公证，无订阅。两款皮肤永久免费，且为完整应用，并非试用版。
products.description: Bloop turns system audio or mic input into eight real-time shader skins - every frame reacts to what's actually playing. Keep it beside your work in the resizable Mini Player or send it to the menu bar. Drop in an MP3 playlist and export the whole thing as a finished video. Apple Silicon, notarized, no subscription. Two skins are free forever, and they're the full app, not a trial.

products.name: Clipnote
products.tagline: Save your AI conversations so they persist after closing tab
products.summaryZh: 保存你的AI对话，以便关闭标签页后内容仍然保留。
products.descriptionZh: 你的ChatGPT和Claude对话在关闭标签页的瞬间就消失了。有了Clipnote，只需告诉你的AI“保存这个”，它就会立即保存——当然，粘贴进去也同样可行。这是一个像记事本一样保存AI对话的地方，之后可以随时回来，从上次中断的地方继续。
products.description: Your ChatGPT and Claude conversations disappear the moment you close the tab. With Clipnote, just tell your AI to "save this" and it's kept on the spot — pasting it in works too, of course. It's a place to keep your AI conversations like a notepad, come back to them later, and pick up right where you left off.

products.name: Remind
products.tagline: Full-screen meeting reminders with AI briefings
products.summaryZh: 全屏会议提醒，附带AI简报
products.descriptionZh: Remind将您的下一次会议呈现在每个屏幕上，附带AI简报，说明您将与谁会面，并提供一键加入按钮。在加入前保持专注。连接Google或Microsoft日历，将相关邮件、Slack和Notion内容带入会议准备中。适用于macOS 14及以上版本。年费19.99美元，提供7天免费试用。
products.description: Remind puts your next meeting on every screen, with an AI briefing on who you are meeting and a one-click join button. Stay focused until it is time to join. Connect Google or Microsoft calendars and bring relevant email, Slack, and Notion context into your meeting prep. For macOS 14+. $19.99/year with a 7-day free trial.

products.name: Nina by Antalpha
products.tagline: Non-custodial AI Agent: research, predict & trade crypto
products.summaryZh: 非托管AI代理：研究、预测与交易加密货币
products.descriptionZh: Nina是Antalpha（纳斯达克：ANTA）推出的非托管AI交易助手。与通用聊天机器人不同，它接入机构级实时数据，以结论为先的方式作答，并配以图表而非大段文字。用日常语言提问，Nina即可起草交易、预测或安全检查方案——由你在自己的钱包上签名确认。现在，一个对话即可覆盖加密货币与美股：市场情报、聪明钱追踪、预测及Polymarket、钱包安全检查——另有Sentinel全天候警报及适用于任意AI客户端的MCP支持。
products.description: Nina is a non-custodial AI trading assistant by Antalpha (NASDAQ: ANTA). Unlike generic chatbots, it's wired to institutional-grade, real-time data and answers conclusion-first, with charts—not walls of text. Ask in plain language; Nina drafts the trade, prediction, or safety check—you sign on your own wallet. One chat now covers crypto and US stocks: market intel, smart-money tracking, predictions & Polymarket, wallet-safety checks—plus Sentinel 24/7 alerts and MCP for any AI client.

products.name: Dash to Cart 2.0
products.tagline: Commerce, kept lightweight.
products.summaryZh: 商务，保持轻量。
products.descriptionZh: Dash to Cart 2.0围绕一个核心理念从头重建：商务应当保持轻量。启动你的店铺，通过Dash to Cart Discovery获得曝光，将符合条件的产品与Google Merchant Centre同步，管理由Stripe驱动的支付与退款，并在一个地方处理税务、配送和自提。深入使用分析、预测、邮件追踪和AI，无需拼凑一套笨重的商务技术栈。
products.description: Dash to Cart 2.0 is rebuilt from the ground up around one idea: commerce should stay lightweight. Launch your store, get discovered through Dash to Cart Discovery, sync eligible products with Google Merchant Centre, manage Stripe-powered payments and refunds, and handle tax, shipping and pickup in one place. Go deeper with analytics, forecasting, email tracking and AI without stitching together a heavyweight commerce stack.

products.name: SwiftXR
products.tagline: Create interactive 3D, AR and VR experiences with AI
products.summaryZh: 使用AI创建交互式3D、AR和VR体验
products.descriptionZh: SwiftXR将AI创作、产品定制与互动分析整合于一体，用于交互式3D、AR和VR体验。此版本推出SwiftXR Assistant：描述您的需求，然后通过对话调整光照、相机角度、尺寸和颜色选项。发布到您的网站或商店，让客户探索产品并在其空间中预览。此次更新还改进了分析功能并支持Web MCP。无需编码。
products.description: SwiftXR brings AI creation, product customisation and engagement analytics together for interactive 3D, AR and VR experiences. This release introduces SwiftXR Assistant: describe what you want, then refine lighting, camera angles, dimensions and colour options through conversation. Publish to your website or store so customers can explore products and preview them in their space. The update also brings improved analytics and Web MCP support. No coding required.

products.name: BotLinx
products.tagline: Build an AI support chatbot from your docs and website
products.summaryZh: 从你的文档和网站构建AI支持聊天机器人
products.descriptionZh: Botlinx是一款面向网站的AI知识库聊天机器人。基于您的PDF进行训练，自动化客户支持，并在几分钟内嵌入智能AI聊天机器人。
products.description: Botlinx is an AI knowledge base chatbot for websites. Train on your PDFs, automate customer support, and embed a smart AI chatbot in minutes.

products.name: Capslane
products.tagline: Reliable YouTube transcripts through one API
products.summaryZh: 通过一个API获取可靠的YouTube转录文本
products.descriptionZh: Capslane为开发者提供稳定的YouTube字幕API。当原生字幕可用时，它会返回原生字幕；缺失时，则自动生成带时间戳的转录文本。获取纯文本或结构化片段，选择语言，管理API密钥，查看使用情况，并通过JavaScript、Python、MCP或n8n进行连接。每月免费提供50次请求。
products.description: Capslane gives developers a stable API for YouTube transcripts. It returns native captions when available and automatically generates a timestamped transcript when they are missing. Get plain text or structured segments, choose a language, manage API keys, inspect usage, and connect through JavaScript, Python, MCP, or n8n. Start with 50 free requests each month.

products.name: Undeadlines
products.tagline: Kill your tasks before they kill you
products.summaryZh: 在任务压垮你之前，先解决它们。
products.descriptionZh: 一款极简周计划工具，以距离为截止期限：你的任务如僵尸般环绕四周，离你越近的，越是迫在眉睫。
products.description: A dead-simple weekly planner where distance is the deadline: your tasks stand around you as zombies, and the nearer one stands, the sooner it is due.

products.name: abha.page 2.0
products.tagline: Turn brand colors into a shippable design system
products.summaryZh: 将品牌色彩转化为可交付的设计系统
products.descriptionZh: Abha 2.0 将色彩构想转化为可直接投产的系统。构建无障碍调色板，在营销页面、产品界面、仪表盘、结账流程、图表、品牌物料、周边及深色模式中全面测试，并导出适用于 CSS、Tailwind、Figma、iOS、Android、Flutter 及 AI 编程工具的令牌。还可从图像中提取颜色、对比方向、对标熟悉产品进行基准测试，并生成可分享的品牌手册。免费使用，无需注册账户。
products.description: Abha 2.0 turns a color idea into a production-ready system. Build an accessible palette, pressure-test it across marketing pages, product UI, dashboards, checkout, charts, brand, merch, and dark mode, then export tokens for CSS, Tailwind, Figma, iOS, Android, Flutter, and AI coding tools. You can also extract colors from an image, compare directions, benchmark against familiar products, and generate a shareable brand book. Free to use, no account required.

products.name: Lexfall
products.tagline: Speak like you belong in the room.
products.summaryZh: 像在场的人一样说话。
products.descriptionZh: Lexfall是一款为已具备良好英语能力的专业人士设计的极简词汇应用。会说英语与会说专业领域的英语并非一回事；当面临高风险的决策时，细微差别至关重要。如果你依赖基础词汇，你的真正专业能力便会大打折扣。Lexfall通过主屏幕小组件，每隔几小时推送一个新词，覆盖医学、法律、商务及通用英语的B2至C2级别词汇。现已上架App Store。
products.description: Lexfall is a minimalist vocabulary app for professionals who already speak well. Speaking English is not the same as speaking your profession's English; when high-stakes decisions are being made, nuance is everything. If you are relying on basic vocabulary, your true expertise gets lost. Lexfall delivers B2–C2 words across Medicine, Law, Business and General English through a home-screen widget that teaches you a new word every few hours. Now on the App Store.

products.name: CosmoDex
products.tagline: World's 1st AI-powered Gamified, competitive Coding Platform
products.summaryZh: 全球首个AI驱动的游戏化竞技编程平台
products.descriptionZh: CosmoDex是一个由AI驱动的游戏化编程平台，将学习编程转变为互动竞技体验。学习Python与SQL，解决挑战，赚取经验值，保持连续学习记录，攀升宇宙联赛排名，并在实时1v1太空对战中与其他程序员一决高下。专为希望编程不再像作业而更像游戏的学生和有抱负的开发者打造。⚔️🚀
products.description: CosmoDex is an AI-powered gamified coding platform that turns learning to code into an interactive competitive experience. Learn Python & SQL, solve challenges, earn XP, build streaks, climb Cosmic League ranks, and battle other coders in real-time 1v1 Space Battles. Built for students and aspiring developers who want coding to feel less like homework and more like a game. ⚔️🚀

products.name: Kitiz
products.tagline: Collect 51 cats and build a bond with every one
products.summaryZh: 收集51只猫咪，与每一只建立羁绊。
products.descriptionZh: Kitiz是一款适用于iOS和Android的免费温馨收集游戏。钓鱼、烹饪、打理花园、为51只独特的猫咪装扮，并通过记住你们共同故事的对话建立个人关系。
products.description: Kitiz is a free cosy collection game for iOS and Android. Fish, cook, grow your garden, dress up 51 unique cats, and build a personal relationship through conversations that remember your shared story.

products.name: Low Qualityfy
products.tagline: Free browser-based meme and image effects editor.
products.summaryZh: 基于浏览器的免费表情包与图片特效编辑器。
products.descriptionZh: Low Qualityfy是一款免费的基于浏览器的图像编辑器和表情包制作工具。可应用深度油炸效果、动态模糊、面部扭曲、像素化及白色文字横幅，然后无水印下载PNG或JPEG文件。图像处理在浏览器本地完成。
products.description: Low Qualityfy is a free browser-based image editor and meme maker. Apply deep-fry effects, motion blur, face distortion, pixelation, and white text banners, then download PNG or JPEG files without a watermark. Image processing happens locally in the browser.
